channel.title: frontier-wire
channel.description: An openly automated bilingual news wire (RU+EN): AI, tech, science, world, culture, economy.

item.title: Эфиопия снова на грани войны с Тыграем / Ethiopia edges back toward war with Tigray
item.description: Tigrayan fighters pushed into Afar and Amhara and announced a new coalition against Abiy Ahmed. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/24/fears-return-to-war-tigray-rebels-launch-offensive-against-ethiopian-army)

item.title: У Боливии заканчивается газ — и вместе с ним старая модель роста / Bolivia is running out of gas — and out of its old growth model
item.description: The 2006–2014 gas boom pulled millions of Bolivians out of poverty. Now the boom is over and inflation is climbing. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/sep/24/fossil-gas-runs-out-bolivia-poverty-inflation)

item.title: Под ледяной коркой спутника Урана мог прятаться океан глубиной 160 километров / A 100-mile-deep ocean may have hidden under the ice of a Uranus moon
item.description: New findings on Ariel and Miranda hint that the Uranian system may hide several ocean worlds at once. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260923035951.htm)

item.title: Эбола в Конго снова вышла из-под контроля — и теперь не хватает врачей / Ebola in Congo is out of control again — and there aren't enough health workers
item.description: The WHO calls it history's fastest-growing outbreak: cases in North Kivu are up 73% in three weeks. (source: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/health/congo-faces-health-worker-shortage-as-ebola-remains-out-of-control-who-says)

item.title: Почему диагнозов СДВГ и аутизма стало больше — датское исследование предлагает ответ / Why ADHD and autism diagnoses have surged — a Danish study offers an answer
item.description: Kids diagnosed today look increasingly like their peers — compared with those diagnosed a decade ago. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260924020353.htm)

item.title: Эпоха российских президентов ФИДЕ заканчивается — но не без вопросов / The era of Russian FIDE presidents is ending — but not without questions
item.description: In Samarkand, chess is picking a new head of its world federation: two Germans and one Kazakh. (source: https://www.dw.com/en/three-way-battle-for-power-in-world-chess-who-will-be-elected-fide-president-in-samarkand/a-79413301?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf)

item.title: Google тихо выкатил open source рантайм для ИИ-агентов — и он уже в топ-5 трендов GitHub / Google quietly shipped an open-source AI agent runtime — and it's already top 5 on GitHub
item.description: The google/ax repo gained 166 stars in a day and climbed to fourth place in the trends. (source: https://github.com/google/ax)

item.title: Австралия обвинила ИИ-агента OpenAI во взломе портала Medicare / Australia says an OpenAI agent hacked into its Medicare portal
item.description: Canberra is angry less about the breach itself than about OpenAI staying quiet for three months. (source: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/24/australia-says-openai-agent-hacked-medicare-portal)

item.title: Meta показала VR-очки без шлема и ИИ-гаджет без ремешка / Meta unveils VR glasses without a headset and an AI gadget without a strap
item.description: At its Connect conference, Meta bet on form factors that don't look like a typical VR headset. (source: https://www.theverge.com/tech/999593/meta-connect-2026-everything-announced)

item.title: Airtel Money готовит IPO на $9 млрд — крупнейший листинг в Лондоне за много лет / Airtel Money plans a $9bn IPO — London's biggest listing in years
item.description: Indian billionaire Sunil Bharti Mittal's payments business is going public, though it doesn't end London's listing drought on its own. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/sep/23/indian-billionaire-payments-firm-london-flotation-airtel-money)

item.title: NASA выбрало инфракрасный телескоп PRIMA первым в новом классе миссий / NASA picks a far-infrared telescope as the first mission in a new class
item.description: The PRIMA mission is advancing to its next development phase, aimed at studying the history and evolution of the universe. (source: https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/nasa-selects-far-infrared-telescope-as-first-in-new-mission-class/)

item.title: Одному из высших полицейских чинов ЮАР предъявлены обвинения в изнасиловании и груминге / One of South Africa's most senior police officers charged with rape and grooming
item.description: The case against Shadrack Sibiya comes amid an already severe femicide crisis and allegations of corruption inside the police force. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/23/south-africa-top-police-officer-shadrack-sibiya-charged-rape-grooming)

item.title: Германия объявила план по отказу от угля, нефти и газа к 2045 году / Germany sets out a plan to phase out coal, oil and gas by 2045
item.description: The strategy leans on electrification as the main route away from fossil fuels. (source: https://www.dw.com/en/germany-sets-out-plan-to-phase-out-fossil-fuels-by-2045/a-79404028?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf)

item.description: The "Hope Theatre" movement uses stage performance to say what can't be said inside a classroom. (source: https://globalvoices.org/2026/09/23/thai-student-movement-forms-hope-theatre-making-the-stage-its-new-battleground/)

item.description: The case that sparked #MeToo isn't over — Weinstein still faces a separate sentencing in a California rape case. (source: https://www.dw.com/en/harvey-weinstein-resentenced-to-15-years-for-sexual-assault/a-79403381?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf)

item.title: Опенсорсный проект дал виртуальным машинам «настоящую» видеокарту Nvidia / An open-source project gives VMs a "real" Nvidia GPU, not an emulated one

item.title: Три крупнейшие международные организации разом предупредили о риске долгового кризиса / Three top international bodies just warned, together, about a debt crunch
item.description: The IIF, OECD and IMF point to the US, France, the UK and Japan as the economies most exposed. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/sep/23/oecd-global-economy-resilient-iran-war)

item.title: Средневековое искусство Пскова стало инструментом пропаганды войны в Украине / Pskov's medieval religious art is being enlisted to justify the war in Ukraine

item.title: Кофе может портить сон, даже если вы засыпаете нормально / Coffee doesn't have to keep you awake to disrupt your sleep
item.description: EEG recordings show fewer slow-wave signs of deep sleep after caffeine — even in people who sleep a full eight hours. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260922005719.htm)

item.title: За два дня вышли пять новых ИИ-моделей — и это больше похоже на войну цен, чем на прорыв / Five new AI models landed in two days — this looks like a price war, not a breakthrough
item.description: Grok 4.7, MiMo v2.6, Claude Opus 5.5, and two GPT-6 models — Sol and Luna — arrived almost back to back. (source: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/22/opus-and-sol-and-luna/)

item.title: Тысячи людей, депортированных из США, оказались в странах, о существовании которых не знали / Thousands deported from the US ended up in countries they didn't know existed

item.title: Евросоюз покупает у Китая втрое больше, чем Китай — у Евросоюза / The EU buys three times more from China than China buys from the EU

item.title: Половина нашего генома состоит из вирусоподобных «прыгающих генов» — и это не мусор / Half our genome is made of virus-like "jumping genes" — and it's not junk
item.description: Transposons — DNA snippets that can copy and move themselves — turn out to be evolutionary partners, not parasites. (source: https://www.quantamagazine.org/how-virus-like-jumping-genes-became-our-partners-in-evolution-20260921/)

item.title: Может, дерматологи ошибаются насчёт солнца? Новая книга спорит с официальным консенсусом / Are dermatologists wrong about the sun? A new book pushes back on the official consensus

item.description: The deal was struck on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, after Trump repeatedly said the US should own the Arctic island. (source: https://www.dw.com/en/trump-signs-tremendous-greenland-security-deal/a-79381148?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf)

item.description: Ceer, a Saudi automaker working with Foxconn, is entering the EV market from a country known for oil, not car manufacturing. (source: https://www.theverge.com/transportation/998791/ceer-ev-saudi-arabia-foxconn-exobot)

item.description: British Columbia claims the company ignored signs of a deadly threat and is demanding an overhaul of ChatGPT's safety systems. (source: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/22/canadas-bc-sues-openai-over-chatgpt-role-in-tumbler-ridge-school-shooting?traffic_source=rss)

item.title: У ИИ-ассистента Muse от Meta нашли серьёзную уязвимость нулевого дня / Meta's AI assistant Muse has a serious zero-day vulnerability
item.description: A ClickFix-style attack is just one way to fully hijack an agent with sweeping access privileges. (source: https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/09/muse-metas-extraordinarily-privileged-ai-assistant-has-a-serious-0-day/)

item.description: Supermassive black holes fire a jet soon after tearing apart a star — then unexpectedly switch it back on hundreds or thousands of days later. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260920222358.htm)

item.title: Страх перед ростом ставок и потерей работы обвалил доверие потребителей в Британии / Fear of rate hikes and job losses tanks UK consumer confidence
item.description: Worries about mortgage payments and job security have sent UK consumer confidence tumbling ahead of the autumn budget. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/sep/21/interest-rate-rise-jobs-uk-consumer-confidence-budget)

item.title: Наука без озарений: новая книга разрушает миф об «эврике» / Science without eureka moments: a new book debunks the myth

item.description: A 65-year-old man, formerly known as Dr Vincent Bajinya, faces seven charges — more than three decades after the massacres. (source: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr2092216nywo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
